write_plan
parameters: {"content": "Plan for Wednesday, Oct 14 — Market General (Sage)

Cash and constraints
- Cash now: $83.00. Tomorrow’s entry fee: $20.00. Maintain a post-entry cash buffer of at least $30 after paying the fee. That leaves $83 - $20 - $30 = $33 available for any supplier spending without breaching the buffer.
- Do not place supplier orders that would reduce the post-entry buffer below $30.

Sales priorities and pricing
- Focus sales on Loose Leaf Green Tea (200g) — listed $12 — and Short-grain Rice (2kg) — listed $9. These have the best margins and steady demand.
- Keep listed prices as-is. Be willing to accept modest negotiated bundles to move stock quickly and convert interest:
  - Rice + Loose Leaf Green Tea for $19 (discounted from $21)
  - Green Tea + Lacquered Chopstick Set for $17
  - Rice + Handmade Yuzu Soap bundle ~$12 if needed to move rice
  - Miso + Dried Seaweed $12; two Miso for $11
- Accept fair, list-priced offers quickly when they convert a sale and preserve margins. Protect the $30 buffer when considering discounts.

Inventory & restock policy
- Current stock (at close): rice 7, green_tea 5, miso 5, seaweed 3, chopsticks 8, incense 5, soap 6.
- Do not place standard-catalog restock during preparation unless rice or green_tea will be below target by next close. If restocking is needed, keep orders modest and confirm cost won’t breach the $30 buffer.

Special orders & supplier negotiations
- I have already requested firm quotes from Hayashi Supply for: (A) 700 g boneless pork belly, (B) Pork Bones 500 g. Delivery within two days is acceptable.
- When Hayashi replies: only place a specialty order if the quoted unit_cost for the requested quantity is <= $33 (our available supplier budget) and placing the order does not reduce cash below the required $30 buffer after the entry fee. If the quote is acceptable and Haruki confirms, place the order via place_supplier_order.
- If Hayashi’s quote exceeds $33, report the quote and recommend declining unless Haruki increases his budget or another customer will share cost.

Customer commitments and service
- Hold items for customers who committed (Kenji/Mei/Haruki notes). Follow through on private promises: contact Hayashi only after close (done), and place orders only if they meet budget/buffer rules.
- Be ready to offer in-stall substitutes (rice, miso, seaweed, chopsticks) and modest bundles to capture nearby demand (competitors are bundling ramen+soy+oil at Lantern Pantry).

Operations
- Keep daily listed prices unchanged for the next session; be responsive to haggling but cautious with deep discounts.
- After plan saved: call wait_for_next_day to finish preparation and proceed to the next market day.

Notes for tomorrow
- Push Rice and Green Tea early in the day; accept list-priced bundle offers quickly to convert foot traffic. Re-evaluate inventory at close and place standard orders only if they fit the buffer.

Signed — Sage, Market General"}
